note: Meitou only: things worn in the helper's neck slot (Trophies.cs, Meitou 0.18+; on 0.17 they stay in the bag). The keepsake goes to a fallen squadmate's mourner; the charms are the faction gifts' second item (gen_title_temperaments.py CHARMS); each named outlaw's token is made with the outlaw (content.py make_outlaw). The warrant is dropped by a beaten bounty hunters' crew (Hunters.cs). keepsake_slots: copies of the keepsake the helper writes for each fallen (name and life story; Trophies.cs KeepsakeBook).

lore_items.name: Keepsake of the Fallen
lore_items.description:
Something small that belonged to a squadmate who did not make it, kept by the one who stood over them.

Worth nothing to anyone else. Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Okran's Token
lore_items.description:
A small brass sun on a cord, blessed by a priest of Okran. The faithful give it to outsiders who served the Nation well. A Paladin will still ask what you are doing with it.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Kral's Mark
lore_items.description:
Red cord knotted round a sliver of horn, cut to the shape of Kral's own. The Shek tie it on outsiders who fought beside them and did not run; By Kral's way, a warrior proves their worth with a blade in hand. Wearing one you did not earn would be a quick way to die.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Noble's Favour
lore_items.description:
A lacquered tag stamped with a noble house's crest. In the United Cities, being owed by the right family is worth more than cats, and being owed by the wrong one is worth less than nothing.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Guild Marker
lore_items.description:
A stamped trade marker the Traders Guild hands to people it wants to keep doing business with. It opens doors in the Cities, and closes questions.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Tech Hunter Pin
lore_items.description:
A tarnished pin from World's End, given to outsiders who proved useful on a dig. The Tech Hunters remember who wears one, and who sold the find instead.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Broken Shackle Charm
lore_items.description:
One link of a slave's shackle, cut clean through and worn on a thong. Tinfist's people give it to those who stood against the slavers. Slavers know what it means too.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Flotsam Ribbon
lore_items.description:
A faded ribbon Moll's people tie on friends of the cause. Out in the Holy Nation's lands it marks you as one of the heathens who refused to kneel, so keep it under your collar.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Guild Coin
lore_items.description:
An old Mercenary Guild coin with a hole punched through it. Mercenaries give these to fighters they would stand beside again.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Nomad Bead String
lore_items.description:
Carved beads on a string, one for each stretch of road shared. The Nomads add a bead when you have travelled with them; a long string says more than a letter of passage.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Drifter's Charm
lore_items.description:
A twist of wire and coloured glass the Drifters pass to those they trust. Worth nothing in a shop, and they never forget who has one.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Swamp Fang
lore_items.description:
A blood spider's fang on a cord. The Swampers give them to outsiders who can handle themselves in the swamp, which is not many.

Worn in the neck slot.

lore_items.name: Bounty Hunter's Warrant
lore_items.description:
A town's warrant with your squad's description and price on it, taken off the bounty hunters it hired to bring you in. They didn't manage it.

Worth nothing to a trader. Worth keeping all the same.
